function: Hybrid analog/digital ISAC precoding (beams for multi-user communication and target sensing) by DRL, updating precoders incrementally under time-varying channels and a moving target (p. 7-8).
system: Wideband ISAC BS with ULAs (Nt=Nr=32), 32 subcarriers, 28 GHz, 3-bit phase shifters; up to 16 single-antenna users, one moving target; no RIS (p. 3, 12).
method: Parameter-shared actor-critic DRL (PSAC) with CNN state encoder, hybrid action (analog phase and digital power increments), POMDP with replay, adaptive loss; offline reinforcement training (p. 7-11).
data_channel: SUMO vehicle and UAV trajectories at an intersection; Wireless InSite ray-traced channels (doubly-selective model, 8 taps); simulated GPS errors; custom GPS-CSI dataset (p. 11-12).
test_conditions: Training curves at SNR 0 dB, U=8; tests sweep SNR, weight psi, users 2-16, velocity 10-30 m/s (same as training range); retraining per point not stated (p. 12-14).
baselines: Non-learned: Opt-based (own SDR plus alternating optimization, perfect state), MP-based predictive precoding [20], Greedy-based [32], Random; learned: DRL w/o PSAC (called DQN in text) (p. 12-14).
metrics: Cumulative reward, averaged spectral efficiency (SE), averaged CRLB of target angle, convergence epochs, running time, complexity orders (p. 12-15).
complexity: Big-O complexity per method (Table VII), actor forward pass linear in U; running time per frame compared in Fig. 15 (p. 15).
openness: Part of the simulation code at https://github.com/ZHYang-PKU/DRL-ISAC (p. 12); dataset not stated as released.
q1_support: p. 12: "sensing channels for each symbol duration are generated using ray-tracing, based on the channel model outlined in Section II"; the authors' own SUMO scene in Wireless InSite, not 3GPP, DeepMIMO, COST 2100 or measured data.
q2_support: p. 14: "conduct simulations of the ISAC performance while maintaining a fixed velocity ranging from 10 m/s to 30 m/s"; Table III (p. 12) trains with the same range, and no statement tests a trained model with another U.
q3_support: p. 12: "MP-based: Predictive precoding scheme in [20]" (non-learned, also Opt-based and Greedy); p. 14: "non-PSAC architectures (DQN in the experiments)", compared on SE and CRLB in Figs. 9 and 12.
q4_support: p. 15: "We further compared the averaged running times within one frame of different schemes in Fig. 15"; Table VII on the same page gives the complexity orders.
q5_support: p. 12: "Some of the simulation codes are available online" at https://github.com/ZHYang-PKU/DRL-ISAC; only part of the code, but a link is given.
notes: Included, area 5: DRL hybrid precoding for ISAC. q1: channels come from Wireless InSite ray tracing of the authors' own SUMO intersection (a commercial tool, not DeepMIMO), counted as a custom simulator; the reviewer may confirm. q3: the learned baseline 'DRL w/o PSAC' is called DQN (p. 14) and classic actor-critic (p. 12) in the text, so it is counted as a standard algorithm, but it could be read as an ablation. q2: no explicit train/test mismatch is stated.
